title: Grand Theft Auto VI: Vice City Preview
description: A preview of Grand Theft Auto VI's return to Vice City, where Jason and Lucia are drawn into a criminal conspiracy across Leonida.
body: Grand Theft Auto VI returns players to Vice City and the wider state of Leonida.
The trailer centers Jason and Lucia as a score pulls them into a larger conspiracy.

title: Grand Theft Auto VI: Trailer Notes
description: A short breakdown of the characters, locations, and high-risk setup shown in Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto VI Trailer 2.
body: The second GTA VI trailer frames Vice City as the setting for a story about trust under pressure.
Jason and Lucia anchor a tour of Leonida's crowded streets, waterways, and nightlife.
